title: Certifications
summary: Credentials and courses with weight: networking, data, regulation, and research.

items.title: Research Paper Writing for Computer Science
items.blurb: How to structure and write CS papers with academic rigor.
body: FIUSAC course on writing computer science research papers: structure, clarity, and academic standards.
Direct foundation for the portfolio’s research track.

items.title: Regulatory Innovation Mechanisms
items.blurb: Regulatory innovation in the digital ecosystem (ITU) — policy context next to technical work.
body: ITU training on regulatory innovation mechanisms in digital environments.
Gives a policy and regulation frame alongside cybersecurity and infrastructure work.

items.title: Building AI-Powered Search with MongoDB Vector Search
items.blurb: Semantic search with embeddings — a base for RAG and AI products.
body: Course on MongoDB Vector Search: embeddings, vector indexes, and semantic retrieval.
Useful for RAG, meaning-based search, and unstructured data.

items.title: CCNA: Introduction to Networks
items.blurb: Networking from scratch: OSI/TCP-IP, IP, and basic device setup.
body: First CCNA module: protocols, IP addressing, and introductory configuration.
Formal networking start after IT Essentials.

items.title: IT Essentials: PC Hardware and Software
items.blurb: Hardware, software, and system support — practical infra foundations.
body: Cisco Networking Academy course on PC assembly, OS support, configuration, and troubleshooting.
Hands-on base for tech support and a path into networking.
